sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Secret Recipe is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I recently got my hands on some sort of diary connected to food development. It's got all sorts of addresses, deliveries, and some weird shit being moved out of TerraGroup offices. Long story short, to make their fancy grub taste so good, those fuckers were adding some unknown ingredient from the labs. And it was addictive, so more people would keep coming back and handing them their money. Made them easier to deal with too... Proper dodgy stuff. Go check what they were hauling out of those offices. Maybe there's still something left behind. The notes keep mentioning some kind of red vial."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the secret ingredient at the TerraGroup office on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the chemical additive

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Nice work, man. Let's see what comes out of this. I got some contacts that can figure it out. I feel like we're in some serious shit again, merc."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Secret component | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| TerraGroup meeting room key | 1 | Required* | N/A | Unlocks the meeting room in the TerraGroup security post building. |
- Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to find the secret component on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout two buildings.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: Turn right immediately after entering the front door, then left at the end of the corridor. Back left corner desk, next to the phone.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: Inside the TerraGroup meeting room, directly on the left when you enter the building. Located on the shelf in the back right.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: Turn left after entering, go to the desk in the back left corner. The vial is located inside a file organizer.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: In the backmost cubicle, located on the desk in the back right.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: In the meeting room at the back right of the office, tucked in a rolled up blueprint.
